_what: Europe PMC bibliographic records fetched to close the journal/volume/page gaps a blind screen of the built submission PDF found in fusion-junction-aso-submission-references.md. One record per cited PMID whose committed entry was missing a journal name, a volume or a page range.
_why: The dev sandbox's egress proxy 403s Europe PMC, NCBI and PMC at CONNECT, so the gaps could not be closed locally. The only alternative to a fetch is typing a volume number from recollection, which is the single thing this repository's first golden rule forbids — and a reference list with an invented volume is worse than one with a visible hole, because the hole is something an author can see.

_provenance.query: (EXT_ID:<pmid> OR ...) AND SRC:MED — one Europe PMC core record per cited PMID, 24 identifiers in one dispatch
_provenance.note: EVERY VALUE BELOW IS COPIED FROM THE FETCHED PAYLOAD. No journal name, volume, issue, page range, year, author list or DOI here was written from recollection, reformatted from a remembered house style, or completed by pattern. Fields Europe PMC did not return are absent rather than filled.

_what_this_is_not: NOT verification that any cited paper supports the sentence it is attached to. These are bibliographic records — evidence that a record exists with that title in that journal at those pages. The support check is human and is automated nowhere in this repository.

NOT an overwrite of anything already held. submission_citations.load_meta merges these into ABSENT fields only, so a journal name already carried by a curated registry entry (a house abbreviation, say) survives and only the genuine gap is closed.
how_it_is_consumed: Listed in submission_citations.HARVEST_SOURCES. `load_meta` walks it for dicts carrying a `pmid` and fills absent fields only. The file is COMMITTED rather than left on literature-cache because CI checks out neither that branch nor any other — the 2026-08-13 red build on PMID 7545436 was exactly a record that existed only on a branch a plain checkout does not have.

the_gaps_this_closes.⚠_the_screen_named_thirteen_and_the_real: The blind screen of the PDF named refs 2, 7, 8, 19, 20, 21, 24, 26, 27, 38, 41, 42 and 45. Re-derived from fusion-junction-aso-submission-references.json rather than from those numbers, the set is twenty: the screen's thirteen are the entries missing a journal or missing BOTH volume and pages, and it did not name refs 3, 9, 29, 30, 31 and 32 (a volume and issue but no page range) or ref 4 (no volume and no pages). All twenty are closed here.

doi_absent_and_that_is_a_measured_absenc.reading: These four already carried journal, volume and pages and were fetched only to ask whether Europe PMC holds a DOI for them. It returns none — they are 1991-2000 papers that predate publisher DOI registration. ⚠ An absent reading is not a reading of absence, so this is recorded as what it is: the field was requested from a source that would have returned it, and came back empty. No DOI is minted, guessed or reconstructed from a publisher's URL pattern for any of them.
